snippet.title: Reel it! Fishing【Nintendo Switch】
snippet.description:
Please make your purchase from here on our e-shop. ↓
America : https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/reel-it-fishing-switch/
Europe/Australia : https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Reel-it-Fishing-2806733.html
Hong Kong : https://ec.nintendo.com/HK/zh/titles/70010000093413
South Korea : https://store.nintendo.co.kr/70010000093412

Please make your purchase from here on our STEAM. ↓
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650090/_/

Swing your rod, reel in your catch, and fish up a big one!
Enjoy a refreshing fishing trip surrounded by nature!

Let's go fishing on the Nintendo Switch™!
Cast your rod at different locations, each with its own unique scenery and fish to catch!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

[Score Attack]
Catch lots of fish and earn points!
Aim for the biggest fish to earn the biggest rewards!
Keep an eye out for rare creatures—there's more than just fish in this river!

[Ranking]
Compete with players from around the world for the highest score!
Show off your skills by increasing your high score and rank!

[Battle]
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode, or test your skills against friends in multiplayer battles!

[Records]
Each fish that you catch in Score Attack or Battle Mode will be recorded in your encyclopedia!
Work hard to reel in every fish and fill out every page!

Game details can be found here 
Reel it! Fishing - Official Japanese Website
https://sat-box.jp/Game/fishing_switch.html
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Official Japanese X(Twitter)：https://x.com/SAT_BOX_2011
